visual.description: Fixed top navigation with logo on the far left, centered nav links with a dropdown indicator, and sign-in plus CTA button grouped on the far right.

Full-viewport black background with oversized left-aligned headline text spanning nearly the full width, no image or split column — pure typographic hero with small sparkle icon accent top-left of text.

Below the hero text, a large light-gray rounded-top card overlaps into the black section, containing a typewriter-style input bar on the left and a 'Create' button on the right, with a circular play button and 'Play teaser video' label centered above the card edge.

Left column (~40% width) has large stacked headline text with a template picker dropdown and CTA buttons; right column (~60% width) shows a rounded video/avatar UI card with a 'Try me' button overlay.
Left column shows a white rounded card with a URL input and 'Scan' button; right column has large headline text with a CTA button, reversing the text/UI column order from the section above.

Left column holds a large bold headline 'Speaks in 120+ languages' with a CTA button; right column shows a blue rounded UI card with a language conversation interface, repeating the left-text / right-product split pattern.
Left column shows a dark rounded card with a code snippet; right column has a large headline 'Embed Formless everywhere' with a CTA, mirroring the UI-left / text-right arrangement.

Left column shows a light-gray rounded card with four embed format icons (Inline, Fullscreen, Popover, Banner); right column continues the 'Embed Formless everywhere' headline and CTA, continuing directly from the previous section scroll.

Left column has a large bold company name headline with a numbered pagination row (1–5); right column shows a dark rounded card with a long testimonial quote, representing a carousel-style social proof layout.
Full-width section with a dark green background showing a large centered browser window mockup of the Formless dashboard with a secondary floating video thumbnail in the upper right corner.
Full-width black background with a single oversized headline 'Collect deeper data' in mixed white and blue text, spanning nearly the entire viewport width.
Minimal full-width black section with a single centered 'Get Started Free' blue button and a small downward chevron below it.

Large white rounded card on a black background containing a logo/brand column on the far left and four link columns (Use cases, Integrations, Resources, Products) with a Typeform copyright line centered at the very bottom.
